entityDescription:
SGS INTRON: INNOVATIVE PARTNER IN BUILDING MATERIALS AND PROCESS
SGS INTRON offers sustainable practical solutions for all your construction-related questions. With over 45 years’ experience in the field of material science, consultancy and innovation, we are your partner for building materials and building processes.
WHAT CAN SGS INTRON DO FOR YOU?
We offer producers, contractors, architects, owners and branch organizations, governments and private parties a wide range of services. You can rely on us for:
▪ Material testing of environmental, mechanical, durability, optical and other properties on either raw materials or (semi) finished products using internationally accepted standards or tailor-made methods
▪ Inspection and examination of (damage to) structures on location
▪ Project management, guidance and advice for all questions regarding construction products and processes
▪ CPR related testing and consultancy
▪ SCC safety examination for your staff
A PARTNER YOU CAN RELY ON
SGS INTRON has an enthusiastic team of highly trained specialists, experienced allrounders and young professionals who offer what you need, whether you have a quick question or a complex problem. We assist you with expert advice, and a personal and complete approach. We can conduct most types of material research in our accredited laboratory and have extensive knowledge of the latest developments concerning regulations; we work with the latest technologies and are constantly renewing and improving our service. In addition, we continuously attend workshops and courses to ensure that our expertise is of the highest standard. This means that you will always receive the best possible solution, of the highest possible standard.
GUARANTEE OF INDEPENDENCE
When you choose SGS INTRON, you choose an independent organization. You can rely on answers and research results that are based on facts. These will be presented in a clear overview with information to get you started immediately. We work in compliance with current standards and have the necessary accreditations from the Accreditation Council. Our independence is verified by an external party. SGS also works in line with the SGS Code of Integrity and guarantees the security you are looking for, at all times.
PART OF A GLOBAL ORGANIZATION
SGS INTRON is part of SGS: the world’s leading company for inspection, verification, testing and certification. SGS is recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. With more than 97,000 employees, SGS operates a network of over 2,600 offices and laboratories around the world.

Geo Space Analytical Services (GeoSAS) was originally established by Dr Menghestab Haile (a British Citizen of Ethiopian Origin) and registered in London in October 2012. The main objective of the company is to provide high quality consultancy services to meet the growing demand for evidence and knowledge-based decision making needs in Africa through the creation of effective partnership with the private sector in the UK and Europe. Anchored on this strategic objective GeoSAS’s vision and mission include:
Vision:
- People: the first point of call for inspiring Africa by creating innovative opportunities to drive human development and seizing the momentum of Africa’s renaissance.
- Portfolio: leaders inknowledge and technology-based services provision that support governments, communities, business enterprises and individuals achieve their developmental aspirations.
- Partners:drivers who nurture platforms for a network of service providers and beneficiaries to jointly create mutually enduring value for society.
- Productivity:a highly effective, lean and fast-moving organization.
 
Mission 
Human Capital
Providing support to public and private education and training provider institutions in policy review, design,implementation and development, including appropriate tools for:TVET systems; distance education, health systems, apprenticeship system, raising skills and employ-ability, e-learning facilities and ICT, mentoring, fostering innovation through imparting in-depth skills, and support private enterprises and public organizations increase workers’ skills to enhance enterprises’ competitive advantage and improve efficiency and effectiveness of public services. 
Natural Resource Management
Introducing climate smart agriculture and effective use of agricultural inputs to increase sustainable production and closing the yield gap by building capacity of farmers through the strengthening of agricultural research centres, public and private agricultural advisory services, farmers’ training centres, and strengthening farmers’ organizations.
Evidence-based information systems
Provide public and private policy decision makers and processes with evidence-based information and analysis and tools in various developmental policy areas, including:climate change adaptation and mitigation strategies, risk and impact analysis, early warning systems, employment creation strategy development, poverty reduction and community resilience building strategies, validation and dissemination of best practices, and promoting inclusive development focusing on women, the unemployed and underemployed youth.
Catalyzing investment in productive sectors
Brokering investment financing partnerships by serving as hub of information on regional and country business opportunities for potential investors, facilitate and assist preparation of feasibility studies and consultancy services for major infrastructure projects, represent and engage with interested international companies to look after their interests, prepare business feasibility studies for potential and prospective profitable business; and supporting governments develop investor friendly and effective regulatory frameworks, including fiscal and financial incentives as appropriate.

Ergonovix inc. is an Ergonomics, Human Factors and Industrial Design consultation firm.
Ergonovix specialises in Virtual Ergonomics with the use of a Digital Human Model (DHM) software from the Dassault Systemes company.

Jeanne Guérin, Principal ergonomist at Ergonovix has extensive years of experience in the fields of space and aerospace at major international firms such as Bombardier Aerospace, Boeing, Blue Origin and Bureau Veritas.
She owns a Bachelor degree in Industrial Design , A Master in the field of Human Factors in a microgravity environnement and a certified Professional Ergonomist designation.
She is also a certified trainer by the Ministry of Work in Québec and a Private pilot with an instrument rating.

Ergonovix is an advanced ergonomics firm offering services in Advanced Ergonomics Design, Virtual Ergonomics, Human Factors Engineering and Industrial Design for the Space and Aerospace sectors.

When a Human is involved an Ergonomist must be involved as well to avoid human errors and risks of injuries.

About Medizinische Universitaet Wien (MUW) or Medical University of Vienna 
The MUW is not only the largest medical organisation in Austria, it is also one of the most important top-level research institutions in Europe and provides Europe's largest hospital, the AKH in Vienna, with all of its medical staff.
With its long history and tradition, which covers 650 years (independent since 01.01.2004), MUW has developed into a highly modern research institution. About 5,700 staff members work in 26 university hospital departments, 2 clinical institutes and 12 centres of medical science. 660,000 patients receive the highest quality treatment from MUW and Vienna General Hospital each year, with 110,000 of them admitted as inpatients. The university’s 8,000 students secure the future of medical treatment.

Triple track strategy
In its structuring and alignment Medical University of Vienna relies on the triple track strategy. Research, education and patient care represent the three cornerstones of the university's system. This enables medical science to respond flexibly to the continually changing demands of the state and society. In the process, maintenance of health as well as therapy, abatement of symptoms and prevention of diseases stand in the foreground.
International competition in relation to medical research and the development of innovative solutions to issues relevant to society such as healthcare or age pyramids are among MUW’s core tasks. Also the disciplines of ethics, medical law, care related research, palliative medicine and health economics are of central importance.

Medical training / Career
MUW is Austria's largest medical training centre and intends to become a leading healthcare player in the future. In the process, extraordinary support measures for highly talented researchers as well as performance related career models for doctors alongside participation in international networks and extra-university cooperation ventures will play a central role.

5 Research Clusters
Inter-disciplinarity and Translational Research are key-words for MUW. Practically all of our organisational units are involved in medical science and medical diagnostic related research.
a. Medical Imaging Cluster (MIC)
b. Allergology/Immunology/Infectiology Cluster (AIIC)
c. Cancer Research/Oncology
d. Medical Neuroscience Cluster (MNC)
e. Cardiovascular Cluster (CVC)
MUW works on innovative research concepts for national and international researchers with the objective of establishing an international competence centre in the spirit of a centre of excellence.

Patient care
The innovative translational research approach is an integral element of MUW’s development plan; as a result of this, considerable opportunities are available to its patients. Through the unique inter-linking of fundamental research with clinical applications, patients benefit directly from the results of clinical studies. A further plus for patients is implementation of the interdisciplinary approach in the core-area: research. Cooperation of all of the doctors concerned with treatment and a bundling of the medical skills represent a decisive factor for success, particularly in relation to the care of cancer patients.

Academic private partnerships
In order to secure additional sources of funding for future research activities, MUW intends to support patenting and the commercial utilisation of research results (the so-called academic private partnership) and has even set up its own service organisation for this purpose.

PLUX was created in 2007 with the ambition of helping the world access human biosignals to improve solutions for health, research and, overall, simplify human-computer interaction scenarios. During its journey PLUX has been able to collaborate in innovative research in a growing number of science fields that use biosignals as key data to improve human health, performance or to expand the frontiers of knowledge. PLUX creates innovative products for Healthcare and Research, by developing advanced biosignal monitoring platforms that integrate wearable body sensors such as electromyography, electrocardiography, respiration, accelerometers, and others, combined with wireless connectivity and software applications to deliver real value recognized by our target markets. PLUX has a significant track record in the creation of innovative added-value products, examples of which include the work on novel technologies for physical rehabilitation (http://www.physioplux.com). An advanced wireless toolkit designed for researchers to collect and analyze reliable, high definition Biosignals data, Biosignalsplux. The latest success case is a DYI product, BITalino, (https://bitalino.com/en/), which in little over five years gathered more than 4000 users, base scattered across more than 30 countries worldwide.
Our mission as company is to create miniaturized sensors and wearable devices for biosignal acquisition and processing. All products aim to provide users with maximum comfort and safety, together with user-friendly software. Given the strong partnerships established with other scientific institutions, PLUX sets the bridge between the academic field and the market, by applying and projecting the research know-ow to problems and practical needs, in several technological areas.
From high know-how on analog-digital filtering and amplification electronics, PLUX can provide the acquired signals with very low noise, high sensitivity and high immunity to electronic interferences. Currently we have a set of biomedical sensors such as, Functional near-infrared spectroscopy sensor (fNIRS), Electroencephalography (EEG), Electrocardiography (ECG), Electromyography (EMG), Electrodermal Activity (EDA), respiration, accelerometer and others, from which several physiological parameters can be extracted, such as: heart rate (HR), heart rate variability (HRV), muscle activation (EMG), sympathetic events from EDA sensors or energy expenditure from an accelerometer. Beyond biomedical sensors, PLUX also has expertise in hardware development, enabling the quick turnaround and discovery of new solutions, new applications, third-party sensors integration and market-focused strategies in the field of biosignal sensing.

entityDescription: Zama is a Paris-based startup building open-source software tools that enable developers to eas-ily deploy secure deep learning applications powered with homomorphic encryption. Zama aims to propel deep learning into a revolutionary new era of privacy-preserving cognition by providing developers with cloud-based and on-premises homomorphic machine learning solutions. Their solutions currently focus on inference rather than training, and are designed for simplicity. Users upload their trained neural networks, which Zama converts into encrypted equivalents with their homomorphic compiler and loads into a runtime environment that distributes processing across a cluster of CPUs, GPUs, and ASICs to enable real-time inference; users can then send encrypted inputs and receive encrypted outputs using a secure API. The complexity of cryptographic optimization is abstracted away from users of Zama’s service, which enables a streamlined migration from existing unencrypted products to end-to-end encrypted equivalents.
